messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-9821 — db-conn-backpressure (sev=high)
PagerDuty: PagerDuty alert: PD-9821 assigned to on-call: Katherine (oncall). Escalation policy: DB & SRE.
Katherine (oncall): ack'd PD-9821. I'm on it. Quick summary?
Incident Bot: Alerts show: Postgres write/txn latency climbing, pgbouncer overflow errors, and downstream 502/503 for app-tier. Thresholds breached at 14:02 UTC.
Sara K: seeing 5xx from the frontends, customers in eu-west and us-east. Dashboard: 20% error rate on /v1/generate.
Ajay Patel: attaching short metrics dump: pgbouncer-clients = 10240 / max_clients 10240, server_active = 980, pool_wait = 120s percentile high.
Mike R: logs showing repeated "server_lost" + "FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved". Likely total DB connections exceeded.
Leo - SRE: Running quick check on replicas and connection pools, will try to alleviate with immediate pgbouncer config tweak.
Katherine (oncall): plan: 1) reduce frontend burst to DB (rate-limit + 429s) 2) increase pgbouncer max_client_conn temporarily 3) failover some read traffic to replicas 4) engage DB team. Doing 1 & 2 now.
Sara K: rolling out a traffic-control rule to limit concurrent generation requests per API key to 4 (via API gateway). Pushing in 30s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ajay Patel: running command to bump pgbouncer (on prod-pgb-1/2):
```
ssh pgbouncer@prod-pgb-1
sudo sed -i 's/max_client_conn = 10240/max_client_conn = 16384/' /etc/pgbouncer/pgbouncer.ini
sudo systemctl reload pgbouncer
```
Mike R: applied on prod-pgb-1, reloading. Watching connection counts. prod-pgb-2 next.
ops-bot: prod-pgb-1: max_client_conn=16384 reload=ok uptime=00:02:15
Leo - SRE: pgbouncer backlog dropped ~70% after reload, but server_active still high. Some backpressure remains from long-running transactions.
Katherine (oncall): Ajay — can you run a quick query to find top long-running queries? Might be model evals or large index maintenance.
Ajay Patel: running this on primary:
```
SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, state, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle' AND now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start > interval '30 seconds'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Ajay Patel: results: several model-batch jobs (job_id 7xx) running ~6-8 minutes, holding locks on embeddings table.
Sara K: those are background offline evals that should be rate-limited. I'm pausing the eval worker queue.
Sara K: `kubectl scale deployment eval-worker --replicas=0 -n jobs` — paused.
Mike R: good, I see server_active falling. 5xx rate trending down from 20% -> 8% in 4m.
Katherine (oncall): notifying customers: posting status update to status.redwood.ai indicating degraded API and partial mitigation in progress.
Incident Bot: Status page update queued: "API degraded — elevated error rates, mitigation in progress. Follow updates here."
PagerDuty: PD-9821 acknowledged by Katherine (oncall) at 14:07 UTC, responders: SRE, DB-Triage.
Leo - SRE: still seeing a tail of slow transactions, I recommend increasing statement_timeout for ingestion jobs and enforcing shorter worker timeouts. Will push change to job config.
Ajay Patel: pushed job config change: added statement_timeout=120000 (2m) for background jobs. Restarting cron workers.
Katherine (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay with mitigation and begin blameless postmortem once stable. If error rate drops below 1% and pgbouncer/server_active < 200 sustained for 15m, we declare mitigated. If not, escalate to oncall manager.
ops-bot: Alert: New Redis errors observed (timeout on ephemeral cache) — might be related to increased frontend throttling.
Sara K: checking redis — hitting client-side timeouts from proxy due to bursty cache misses. Implementing soft TTL fallback and circuit-breaker to reduce propagation.
Mike R: summary at 14:30 UTC: error rate now ~0.9%, pgbouncer active ~160, long-running queries reduced. Critical customers flagged: cust-42 (eu), cust-73 (us-east) had degraded requests.
Katherine (oncall): creating PD incident note and tagging customer success: @customer-success to reach out to flagged customers and offer a retro.
PagerDuty: PD-9821 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring at 14:35 UTC.
Incident Bot: PD-9821 will be auto-closed in 1h if no regressions.
Katherine (oncall): handoff to Leo - SRE for overnight watch and brief postmortem doc. Thanks team — keep eyes on alerts. :white_check_mark:
